description: This file defines a settings dialog component for the Notesnook application, including UI layout, navigation, and rendering of various settings sections and items.

methods.name: SettingsDialog
methods.description: Main component rendering the settings dialog with sidebar navigation and settings groups.

methods.name: SettingsSideBar
methods.description: Component rendering the sidebar with search and navigation items for settings sections.

methods.name: SettingsGroupComponent
methods.description: Component rendering a group of settings, including header and individual setting items.

methods.name: SettingItem
methods.description: Component rendering an individual setting item with controls like toggle, button, input, or dropdown.

methods.name: SelectComponent
methods.description: Component rendering a dropdown select for settings options.
